name: Gujarat Terce Laboratories Limited
summary: Gujarat Terce Laboratories Ltd. operates as a pharmaceutical enterprise, focusing on the production and distribution of various medicinal items. Its comprehensive product range addresses diverse therapeutic areas such as anti-fungal, anti-malarial, and antibiotic treatments, in addition to ayurvedic, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, gynecological, and respiratory care. The company also offers nutraceuticals, pain relief solutions, and other specialized pharmaceutical products. Mr. N.P. Prajapati founded the company on March 28, 1985, and it is presently based in Ahmedabad, India.
